message.content:
Word counts: A runs about 85 words, slightly over the acceptable range. B runs about 50 words, well under 60.

**A.** It develops the fairy-tale mechanism concretely: evil punished, a template carried into adulthood, life measured against a childhood standard. The voice fits. It drifts into a generic closing setup ("what to put in place"), which stays restrained and not motivational. There are minor orthographic errors ("когда то", "как то").

**B.** It is too short. It barely engages the fairy-tale and childhood point. It contains a grammatical error ("перестаёт вписаться") and the odd phrasing "не обязана" without a complement. It ends on a quotable aphorism.

On balance, A is better on length, development and grammar.
